title: A physics-constrained deep reinforcement learning method for autonomous mission planning of Titan deep space probes
abstract: arXiv:2611.15389v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Titan is a compelling target for future deep space exploration, while its extreme Earth-Titan distance and complex environment make continuous ground-in-the-loop planning impractical. Existing planning methods, primarily developed for Earth-observation scenarios, have limited generalizability to uncertain deep space conditions and adaptability to time-varying mission states. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a physics-constrained maskable proximal policy optimization (PCM-PPO) method for Titan autonomous mission planning. A Titan-specific discrete-time Markov decision process is established to characterize mission feasibility and resource constraints. A system dynamics and geometric model is incorporated to enhance physical representation, including central gravity, J2 perturbation, third-body attraction, and downlink occultation. translated_title: 面向泰坦深空探测器自主任务规划的物理约束深度强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 泰坦是未来深空探测极具吸引力的目标，然而其遥远的地球-泰坦距离以及复杂的环境使得持续的地面在环任务规划难以实现。现有的规划方法主要针对对地观测场景开发，在不确定的深空条件下泛化能力有限，且对时变任务状态的适应性不足。为应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种用于泰坦自主任务规划的物理约束可掩蔽近端策略优化方法（PCM-PPO）。论文建立了泰坦专用的离散时间马尔可夫决策过程，以刻画任务可行性与资源约束；并引入系统动力学与几何模型以增强物理表征能力，包括中心引力、J2摄动、第三体引力摄动以及下行链路掩蔽。为在有界动作维度下适应机会性目标，PCM-PPO对预定义的动作空间进行组织……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种物理约束的可掩蔽近端策略优化方法（PCM-PPO），通过将泰坦专用动力学与几何模型（中心引力、J2摄动、第三体引力、下行链路掩蔽）嵌入离散时间马尔可夫决策过程，实现泰坦深空探测器在不确定环境与时变任务状态下的自主任务规划。
